title: 18619 - 18619/P2187/008583
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Mass Air Flow Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G70)
Kontrol edin:  Activated Charcoal Filter (EVAP) System Solenoid Valve 1 (N80)
technicalNotes:
When found in the NAR 2.0T (BPY) check RVUTB: 01-09-03  or  2018919 for updated Crankcase Breather Valve
If the breather valve is faulty, full engine vacuum is typically found when removing the oil cap at idle.
2008-2013 VW with CCTA or CBFA, TB 10-12-01 or TPI 2025501 has additional CCV testing information:
https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2012/SB-10073981-2280.pdf  NHTSA
2005-2010 Audi with the following engines, see TSB 01-12-44 or TPI 2015505:
BPG - BPY - BWT - CCTA - CDMA
https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2012/SB-10043872-9159.pdf  NHTSA
